title: Pleiades Rosette Foldout
description: Astronomical foldout, folio 68 recto panel 3 (Beinecke MS 408). Nine rosette diagrams in a 3×3 grid.

title: Great Rosette Foldout
description: Six-panel foldout featuring circular diagrams with blue radiating patterns.
storyNotes: CRITICAL CONNECTION: The radiating geometric patterns mirror the Notae symbols in Ars Notoria manuscripts.

title: Forked Root Plant
description: Single large plant with green rounded leaves and distinctive forked root system.

title: Paired Plants
description: Two plants side by side with contrasting leaf types.

title: Pharmaceutical Vessels
description: Three tiered vessels along left margin. Rows of hanging dried specimens.
storyNotes: CRITICAL: These vessels match alchemical apparatus.

title: Extended Pharmaceutical Foldout
description: Four-panel foldout showing extensive pharmaceutical preparations.

title: Walking Root Plant
description: Plant with blue cross-shaped flowers and animal-like walking root system.

title: Marine Specimen Recipe
description: Complex recipe page with vessels, roots, and marine creatures.

title: Recipe Text - Star Markers
description: Dense text page with red star paragraph markers.

title: Sparse Final Page
description: Mostly blank final page with small figure drawing.

title: Book Spine
description: Vellum binding spine with age patina.

title: Back Cover
description: Full back cover showing limp vellum binding.

title: Ornamental Notae with Swords
description: Decorative page with organic scrollwork patterns. Upper section shows seven sword-like elements. Red ink throughout.
storyNotes: The seven swords may represent the seven liberal arts.

title: Columnar Notae with Star Burst
description: Vertical columnar structure with braided pillar. Six-pointed star burst in upper right. Circular diagrams at bottom.
storyNotes: Star burst may represent divine illumination.

title: Geometric Notae Compendium
description: Multiple geometric figure types in a grid. Central tree-like structure growing from roots.
storyNotes: CRITICAL REFERENCE: Compendium of notae figure types. Compare to Voynich f.85v-86r rosettes.

title: Pillars and Feather Notae
description: Multiple vertical columnar structures. Large feather-like central element. Face-like circular diagrams.
storyNotes: Pillar forms may represent temple imagery connected to Solomon.

title: Hexagonal Trefoil Network
description: Six trefoil forms in hexagonal pattern. Eye-shaped diagram below.
storyNotes: Trefoil suggests Trinity symbolism. Eye may represent divine sight.

title: Three Pillars of Philosophy
description: Three vertical elements: arrow pillar with quatrefoil, circle chain, and compass figure.
storyNotes: SIGNIFICANT: Three pillars may represent trivium or branches of philosophical knowledge.

title: Page Layout Diagram
description: Structural layout with four semicircular fan patterns in corners. Rectangular text boxes.

title: Twin Sphere Cosmological Figure
description: Two circular diagrams connected by flowing channels. Infinity-like flow pattern.
storyNotes: COSMOLOGICAL: May represent circulation between celestial and terrestrial realms. Compare to Voynich biological tubes.

title: Circle Mesh Network
description: Large mesh of interconnected circles. Vertical spine on right edge.
storyNotes: IMPORTANT: Network represents interconnected nature of knowledge in Ars Notoria.

title: Flowing Knowledge Tree
description: Interconnected circles of varying sizes connected by flowing lines. Organic appearance.
storyNotes: KEY DIAGRAM: Map of how knowledge areas flow into each other. Parallels Voynich biological imagery.

title: Triple Venn Intersection
description: Three overlapping circles in Venn diagram style. Central intersection represents unified knowledge.
storyNotes: THEOLOGICAL: Triple intersection represents Trinity and unified divine knowledge.

title: Celestial Sphere with Text
description: Text-heavy page with circular diagram at bottom showing celestial pattern.
storyNotes: Circular arrangement may represent planetary spheres.

title: Trinitarian Circle Oration
description: Three connected circles in triangular arrangement filled with prayer text.
storyNotes: PRAYER FORMAT: Standard Trinitarian invocation pattern. Blake needs this for effective invocation.

title: Diamond Text Container
description: Large diamond shape filled with Latin text. Dense marginal annotations.
storyNotes: Diamond may represent four elements or cardinal directions.

title: Concentric Prayer Wheel
description: Four concentric circles with spiral Latin text. Classic wheel diagram.
storyNotes: MEDITATION AID: Spiral text read while tracing circles creates meditative practice.
